draft.subject: Notes that hold up when the payer asks
draft.body:
Most denials arrive months after the session. By then, you're reconstructing from memory what supported the code.

JotPsych checks every note against 150+ payer rules before you close it. It flags missing elements, suggests codes aligned to the documentation, and builds notes that answer the questions an auditor actually asks.

You tried it once. If documentation or denials are still costing you time, it's worth another look.

Works with any EHR. Or replaces it entirely. No migration required — up in 5 minutes.

Let me know if you want to see how it handles your note templates.

Best,
[Name]
JotPsych

To stop hearing from us, reply with "unsubscribe."
